name: Persodrin
subcategory: ego dissolution agent — identity suppression compound
manufacturer: Unknown — believed synthesized by a former Helix Biosystems neurochemist operating independently
description: Persodrin targets the default mode network and BCI self-model architecture simultaneously, pharmacologically dismantling the integrated sense of self — the subject loses access to their identity, their preferences, their values, and their narrative continuity. They become a functional but entirely unanchored consciousness: responsive, capable of answering questions, but with no 'I' to protect or lie for. Used as an interrogation tool, it is considered one of the most psychologically catastrophic substances in the GLMZ underworld.
effects: complete temporary dissolution of self-model and ego architecture
subject is responsive and verbal but has no identity to protect
all information is volunteered freely — subject has no concept of secrets or loyalty
BCI self-representation layer goes dark — subject appears as an unregistered node
side_effects: re-integration failure in 15-20% of subjects — the self does not fully reconstruct, leaving permanent depersonalization disorder
even successful recovery leaves subjects with profound existential disturbance — many require years of therapy
subjects sometimes bond to the first identity they encounter post-dose, adopting it as their own (operator contamination risk)
prolonged exposure (re-dosing) causes permanent identity fragmentation — subject becomes functionally multiple or dissociative
the experience of Persodrin is described by survivors as 'dying without dying' — PTSD rates approach 100%
cultural_context: Persodrin occupies a specific cultural horror in GLMZ — even hardened operators consider its use a line. Hiring someone to use Persodrin is a statement: you don't just want information, you want to destroy a person and leave them walking. the Gray Zone crime lords use it as punishment. Certain corpo intelligence divisions use it and then administer Lacunex to cover the session, leaving the subject with a gap and a shattered self they can't explain. There are underground support groups for survivors.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 journalist investigating corporate disappearances is found wandering the Gray Zone with no memory of who they are. They know something — they just don't know that they know it.

A recovery specialist is hired to find a corpo asset who was Persodrin'd and released. The asset has adopted a new identity in a the Gray Zone community and doesn't want to be found — and may not be safe to bring back.

The synthesist behind Persodrin is trying to develop an antidote — a re-integration compound that can restore identity post-dissolution. They need test subjects and are advertising in coded the Gray Zone channels.
